source.label: 2025 Universal Registration Document, consolidated cash flow statement (total tax paid)
2025 Universal Registration Document, management report section 5.2 Research and development costs

notes: Taxes: the consolidated cash flow statement's own 'TOTAL TAX PAID' (EUR 4,901m), which covers tax paid in operating activities (EUR 4,656m), tax paid related to interim and final dividends (EUR 244m, on intra-group dividends, in financing activities) and tax on investment disposals (nil); the printed parts sum to 4,900, so the total carries rounding. Operating-only figure would be 4.66. R&D: LVMH reports no R&D line in the income statement; the management report gives research and development investments of EUR 200m (mainly scientific research for skincare and makeup in Perfumes and Cosmetics); the accounting policy states research expenditure is not capitalized, so it is treated as expensed.
